notes: blended over 6 economies for market scope 'Europe': ch 15%, cn 10%, de 24%, fr 16%, gb 15%, us 20%. The blend is a weighted sum of per-economy distributions, per period.
the window 2006-08 to 2024-12 (216 months) is the overlap of the contributors. The narrowest is cn (2006-08 to 2024-12), which sets it. A backtest cannot run longer than this.
each contributing distribution is an annual macro assessment held flat within its year, blended with a monthly technical signal. All intra-year variation is technical.
the contributing economies are in different capital-cycle phases ([2, 4]), so the blend has no single phase and none is reported. That disagreement is a finding about the scope, not a defect.

provenance.blend: weighted sum of per-economy distributions per period
provenance.macro_to_monthly: step hold within each year, no interpolation
